summary: Iteration 8. Wallet modal: PASS. No 'Payment API', 'pluggable' or 'MOCK' text and no payment-config-toggle. Deposit (permanent address + QR, coin switch), withdraw (validation toast) and recent activity all work. Sidebar: PASS on desktop 1920. The pill tabs work (Sport is active; Casino goes to /casino). The 'Top Sports' card shows a total badge, 6 items with colored icons, and the animated active highlight. Clicking an item filters the events. The odds feed is empty, so all counts are 0 and the LIVE badges could not be checked. Blackjack resume: PASS. Stake 0.37, coin USDT, inputs disabled, and the Insurance chip goes 'taken' -> 'no win' after stand. Parallel deals: PASS (1x200, 7x400). Parallel 'stand' only (25 rounds): PASS. Blackjack race: FAIL, CRITICAL. Sending 16 mixed hit/stand calls at once still settles a hand twice (3 of 36 rounds). pytest test_blackjack.py: 16/16 pass after 2 test-file fixes.

critical.issue: Lock-release race: a hand can still be settled twice and paid wrongly. Request A runs _bj_save, whose replace_one sets lock=False. Before A's finally block runs, request B claims the lock (lock=True). A's finally update_one({id, lock:True}) -> lock=False then releases B's lock. Request C then claims the hand while B is still working, and B and C both apply moves to the same state. Seen in game cec8f36a: one 'stand' paid a win of 0.2 USDT while a parallel 'hit' busted. Two casino_games records exist, the wallet got +0.2, but the stored bj_game says bust / total_payout 0. Game 74a23f27 also has 2 duplicate history records.

minor.issue: An unknown or foreign game_id returns 409 'Hand is busy, try again' instead of 404/400. The lock claim query is used for both checks.
No stale-lock recovery. If the process dies while the lock is held, the hand stays 409 forever and the user can never deal again (the open hand blocks new deals).

ui_bugs.issue: After a resume, the side-bet inputs are not restored from game.sides, and the 'Total bet' line leaves out insurance and resumed side bets (it shows 0.37 while 0.555 is at stake)

issues: Am. Football uses a Shield icon and Baseball uses a CircleDot. These are generic and could be swapped for more recognisable icons (minor). Layout, spacing and contrast look good.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix the blackjack lock with an ownership token. In bj_action: token=uuid4(); claim with find_one_and_update({id, user_id, lock:{$ne:True}}, {$set:{lock:token}}). In _bj_save: do not set lock=False; save with replace_one({id, lock: token}, g_with_lock_token) and check matched_count. In finally: update_one({id, lock: token}, {$set:{lock: False}}). Safer still: run the finish/payout only after a conditional status update ({id, status:{$ne:'done'}}) succeeds, so _adjust/_record_game can never run twice. Re-run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... python backend/tests/race_probe_blackjack_mixed.py (expect 0 mismatches and records-per-hand {1}).
Return 404 for an unknown game_id in bj_action: check that the hand exists before treating a failed claim as busy (409).
Add a stale-lock expiry, e.g. store lock_at and allow a reclaim after ~10s.
Low: on resume, restore the side-bet inputs from game.sides and include insurance in the Total bet line.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2184 lines and should be split into modules (casino/blackjack, wallet, sportsbook, admin).
_bj_finish credits the wallet (_adjust) and records history before the state is saved under a guarded condition. Any concurrency hole therefore turns into money loss. Make settlement idempotent.
bj_deal imports DuplicateKeyError inside the function. Move it to module level.

rca of the issue: bj_action claims the lock with lock:{$ne:True} -> True, but the release is unconditional on owner. _bj_save writes lock=False via replace_one, and then the finally block sets lock False for whichever request currently holds it. The overlap lets 2 requests work on the same snapshot, and both run _bj_finish -> _adjust + _record_game. Reproduce with race_probe_blackjack_mixed.py (about 8% of rounds). Mitigation: a per-request lock token used in the claim, the save and the release, plus an idempotent settlement guard.
